    24	  const worldToCell = (x, z) => [
    25	    (((x - OX) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1),
    26	    (((z - OZ) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1),
    27	  ];
    28	  function stamp(px, pz, radius, inner, target) {
    29	    const [cx, cy] = worldToCell(px, pz);
    30	    const cr = Math.ceil(radius / CELL) + 1;
    31	    for (let dy = -cr; dy <= cr; dy++) for (let dx = -cr; dx <= cr; dx++) {
    32	      const gx = Math.round(cx) + dx, gy = Math.round(cy) + dy;
    33	      if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= G || gy >= G) continue;
    34	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
    35	      const d = Math.hypot(x - px, z - pz);
    36	      if (d > radius) continue;
    37	      const i = gy * G + gx;
    38	      const cand = lerp(field0[i], Math.min(field0[i], target), smoothstep(radius, inner, d));
    39	      if (cand < field[i]) field[i] = cand;
    40	    }
    41	  }
    42	  // wider, softer valley profile: gentle grassed banks instead of a trench
    43	  for (const p of RIVER_PTS) stamp(p[0], p[1], 50, 17, p[2] - 1.8);
    44	  // …and a tight channel stamped along the RIBBON SPLINE itself: the water
    45	  // mesh follows the Catmull-Rom curve between the OSM points, which bulges
    46	  // off the point-stamped corridor on bends and left the river beheaded by
    47	  // untouched ground in places
    48	  {
    49	    // stamps every ~5.5m: at the old 11m spacing the r=8 deep zones waisted
    50	    // between samples and the channel bed rose in ridges (the river read as
    51	    // disconnected pools)
    52	    const SAMP = Math.min(3000, RIVER_PTS.length * 8);
    53	    for (let i = 0; i <= SAMP; i++) {
    54	      const [x, z, y] = sampleSpline(RIVER_PTS, i / SAMP);
    55	      stamp(x, z, 26, 9, y - 1.9);
    56	      // shallow SHELF to 16m: guarantees no 17m-cell terrain triangle can
    57	      // bulge up through the bank apron mid-collar (the black-wedge bug)
    58	      stamp(x, z, 30, 16, y - 0.55);
    59	    }
    60	  }
    61	  for (const s of STREAMS) {
    62	    for (const p of s.pts) stamp(p[0], p[1], 24, 6, p[2] - 0.8);
    63	    const SAMP = s.pts.length * 4;
    64	    for (let i = 0; i <= SAMP; i++) {
    65	      const [x, z, y] = sampleSpline(s.pts, i / SAMP);
    66	      stamp(x, z, 10, 3.5, y - 0.75);
    67	    }
    68	  }
    69	  // the mill-pond basin: a real dished bed at the Gauja bend so the pond
    70	  // water body meets the mill and dam instead of hovering on the bank
    71	  {
    72	    const P = LOC.POND, lvl = LOC.POND_LEVEL;
    73	    const RX = 56, RZ = 38;
    74	    for (let gy = 0; gy < G; gy++) for (let gx = 0; gx < G; gx++) {
    75	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
    76	      const nx = (x - (P.x + 4)) / RX, nz = (z - P.z) / RZ;
    77	      const rr = Math.hypot(nx, nz);
    78	      if (rr < 1.15) {
    79	        const i = gy * G + gx;
    80	        const bed = lvl - 1.2 + smoothstep(0.7, 1.15, rr) * 2.6;
    81	        field[i] = Math.min(field[i], Math.max(bed, lvl - 1.2));
    82	      }
    83	    }
    84	  }
    85	
    86	  // pads (farmyards) flatten
    87	  for (const p of PADS) {
    88	    const cgx = Math.round((((p.x - OX) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1));
    89	    const cgy = Math.round((((p.z - OZ) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1));
    90	    if (p.y === undefined) p.y = field[cgy * G + cgx];
    91	    const cr = Math.ceil((p.r + 24) / CELL) + 1;
    92	    for (let dy = -cr; dy <= cr; dy++) for (let dx = -cr; dx <= cr; dx++) {
    93	      const gx = cgx + dx, gy = cgy + dy;
    94	      if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= G || gy >= G) continue;
    95	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
    96	      const d = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.z - z);
    97	      if (d < p.r + 24) {
    98	        const i = gy * G + gx;
    99	        field[i] = lerp(field[i], p.y, smoothstep(p.r + 24, p.r * 0.55, d));
   100	      }
   101	    }
   102	  }
   103	  // lake beds: make sure they dip below their waterlines
   104	  for (const lake of LAKES) {
   105	    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
   106	    for (const [x, z] of lake.poly) {
   107	      minX = Math.min(minX, x); maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
   108	      minZ = Math.min(minZ, z); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, z);
   109	    }
   110	    for (let gy = 0; gy < G; gy++) for (let gx = 0; gx < G; gx++) {
   111	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
   112	      if (x < minX - CELL || x > maxX + CELL || z < minZ - CELL || z > maxZ + CELL) continue;
   113	      if (pointInPoly(x, z, lake.poly)) {
   114	        const i = gy * G + gx;
   115	        field[i] = Math.min(field[i], lake.level - 1.3);
   116	      }
   117	    }
   118	  }
   119	  // burial barrows (low mounds — they stay in the land once raised)
   120	  for (const b of BUMPS) {
   121	    const gr = Math.ceil((b.r + 2) / CELL);
   122	    const cgx = Math.round((((b.x - OX) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1));
   123	    const cgy = Math.round((((b.z - OZ) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1));
   124	    for (let dy = -gr; dy <= gr; dy++) for (let dx = -gr; dx <= gr; dx++) {
   125	      const gx = cgx + dx, gy = cgy + dy;
   126	      if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= G || gy >= G) continue;
   127	      const [x, z] = cellToWorld(gx, gy);
   128	      const d = Math.hypot(x - b.x, z - b.z);
   129	      if (d < b.r) field[gy * G + gx] += b.h * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.cos((d / b.r) * Math.PI));
   130	    }
   131	  }
   132	})();
   133	
   134	// cached lake bounds for cheap margin tests during painting
   135	for (const lake of LAKES) {
   136	  let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
   137	  for (const [x, z] of lake.poly) {
   138	    minX = Math.min(minX, x); maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
   139	    minZ = Math.min(minZ, z); maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, z);
   140	  }
   141	  lake.cx = (minX + maxX) / 2; lake.cz = (minZ + maxZ) / 2;
   142	  lake.hx = (maxX - minX) / 2 + 40; lake.hz = (maxZ - minZ) / 2 + 40;
   143	}
   144	
   145	// ---- height queries -------------------------------------------------------
   146	function baseHeight(x, z) {
   147	  const fx = clamp((((x - OX) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1), 0, G - 1.001);
   148	  const fz = clamp((((z - OZ) / SPAN) + 0.5) * (G - 1), 0, G - 1.001);
   149	  const x0 = Math.floor(fx), z0 = Math.floor(fz);
   150	  const u = fx - x0, v = fz - z0;
   151	  const h = (xx, zz) => field[Math.min(zz, G - 1) * G + Math.min(xx, G - 1)];
   152	  return lerp(lerp(h(x0, z0), h(x0 + 1, z0), u), lerp(h(x0, z0 + 1), h(x0 + 1, z0 + 1), u), v);
   153	}
   154	function microDamp(x, z) {
   155	  let damp = 1;
   156	  for (const p of PADS) damp = Math.min(damp, smoothstep(p.r * 0.6, p.r + 10, Math.hypot(x - p.x, z - p.z)));
   157	  damp = Math.min(damp, smoothstep(14, 26, distToRiver(x, z))); // micro noise must not breach the shore
   158	  // main-road corridors ride a draped ribbon: micro bumps bigger than its
   159	  // crown swallowed the carriageway in stretches
   160	  const ri = distToRoadEx(5, x, z);
   161	  if (ri.c <= 1 && ri.d < 14) damp = Math.min(damp, smoothstep(4, 14, ri.d));
   162	  return damp;
   163	}
   164	export function heightAt(x, z) {
   165	  const micro = (noise.fbm(x * 0.045, z * 0.045, 2) - 0.5) * 0.7 * microDamp(x, z);
   166	  return baseHeight(x, z) + micro;
   167	}
   168	export function slopeAt(x, z) {
   169	  const e = 2;
   170	  return Math.hypot(heightAt(x + e, z) - heightAt(x - e, z), heightAt(x, z + e) - heightAt(x, z - e)) / (2 * e);
   171	}
   172	
   173	// ---- mesh -----------------------------------------------------------------
   174	const RES = 512;
   175	let terrainMesh = null;
   176	
   177	// high-frequency detail so the ground doesn't read as flat vertex paint —
   178	// multi-octave albedo modulation + a bump channel for micro-relief
   179	// (tussocks, soil crumb), and a slope rule that bares the glacial till on
   180	// steep river banks. All in world space so it survives the vertex paint.
   181	let detailTex = null;
   182	function makeDetailTex() {
   183	  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
   184	  c.width = c.height = 256;
   185	  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
   186	  const img = ctx.createImageData(256, 256);
   187	  const n = makeNoise(515);
   188	  for (let y = 0; y < 256; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 256; x++) {
   189	    const v = (n.fbm(x / 34, y / 34, 4) * 0.7 + n.noise2(x / 6.5, y / 6.5) * 0.3) * 255;
   190	    const i = (y * 256 + x) * 4;
   191	    img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
   192	    img.data[i + 3] = 255;
   193	  }
   194	  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
   195	  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
   196	  tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.MirroredRepeatWrapping; // seamless tiling
   197	  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
   198	  return tex;
   199	}
   200	function detailify(material, strength) {
   201	  if (!detailTex) detailTex = makeDetailTex();
   202	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
   203	    sh.uniforms.uDetail = { value: detailTex };
   204	    sh.uniforms.uDetailK = { value: strength };
   205	    sh.vertexShader = 'varying vec3 vWp; varying float vSlope;\n' + sh.vertexShader.replace(
   206	      '#include <begin_vertex>',
   207	      `#include <begin_vertex>
   208	       vWp = (modelMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;
   209	       vSlope = 1.0 - normalize(normal).y;`
   210	    );
   211	    sh.fragmentShader = 'uniform sampler2D uDetail; uniform float uDetailK; varying vec3 vWp; varying float vSlope;\n' +
   212	      sh.fragmentShader.replace(
   213	        '#include <color_fragment>',
   214	        `#include <color_fragment>
   215	        {
   216	          float d0 = texture2D(uDetail, vWp.xz * 0.31).r;   // soil crumb
   217	          float d1 = texture2D(uDetail, vWp.xz * 0.09).r;   // tussocks
   218	          float d2 = texture2D(uDetail, vWp.xz * 0.011).r;  // field-scale patchiness
   219	          diffuseColor.rgb *= mix(1.0, (0.84 + 0.3 * d0) * (0.74 + 0.5 * d1) * (0.8 + 0.4 * d2), uDetailK);
   220	          // sward speckle: on green ground a ~1m turf grain carries the
   221	          // grass illusion far beyond the instanced blade rings
   222	          float sward = texture2D(uDetail, vWp.xz * 0.9).r;
   223	          float greenK = clamp((diffuseColor.g - diffuseColor.r) * 5.0, 0.0, 1.0);
   224	          diffuseColor.rgb *= mix(1.0, 0.8 + 0.38 * sward, greenK * uDetailK);
   225	          // steep ground bares mineral soil / till between the grass
   226	          float bare = smoothstep(0.16, 0.45, vSlope + (d1 - 0.5) * 0.14);
   227	          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb,
   228	            vec3(0.40, 0.345, 0.26) * (0.7 + 0.5 * d0), bare * 0.75 * uDetailK);
   229	        }`
   230	      );
   231	  };
   232	  return material;
   233	}
   234	
   235	// exact height of the RENDERED terrain surface (the mesh's own triangles).
   236	// heightAt() is the smooth field; between the 17m mesh vertices the two can
   237	// differ by up to ~1m, which swallowed draped geometry like the roads.
   238	let meshH = null;
   239	export function meshHeightAt(x, z) {
   240	  if (!meshH) return heightAt(x, z);
   241	  const { arr, x0, z0, sx, sz, n } = meshH;
   242	  // signed steps: after rotateX(-PI/2) the vertex rows run in DECREASING z
   243	  const fx = clamp((x - x0) / sx, 0, n - 1.001);
   244	  const fz = clamp((z - z0) / sz, 0, n - 1.001);
   245	  const c = Math.floor(fx), r = Math.floor(fz);
   246	  const u = fx - c, v = fz - r;
   247	  const hA = arr[r * n + c], hB = arr[r * n + c + 1];
   248	  const hC = arr[(r + 1) * n + c], hD = arr[(r + 1) * n + c + 1];
   249	  // PlaneGeometry splits each cell A-B / C-D along the B-C diagonal
   250	  if (u + v <= 1) return hA + (hB - hA) * u + (hC - hA) * v;
   251	  return hD + (hC - hD) * (1 - u) + (hB - hD) * (1 - v);
   252	}
   253	
   254	export function buildTerrain() {
   255	  const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(SPAN, SPAN, RES - 1, RES - 1);
   256	  geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
   257	  geo.translate(OX, 0, OZ);
   258	  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
   259	  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
   260	    pos.setY(i, heightAt(pos.getX(i), pos.getZ(i)));
   261	  }
   262	  // record the rendered grid for meshHeightAt
   263	  {
   264	    const n = RES;
   265	    const arr = new Float32Array(n * n);
   266	    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) arr[i] = pos.getY(i);
   267	    meshH = {
   268	      arr, n,
   269	      x0: pos.getX(0), z0: pos.getZ(0),
   270	      sx: pos.getX(1) - pos.getX(0),
   271	      sz: pos.getZ(n) - pos.getZ(0),
   272	    };
   273	  }
   274	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
   275	  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(pos.count * 3), 3));
   276	  if (!detailTex) detailTex = makeDetailTex();
   277	  const bump = detailTex.clone();
   278	  // 12m tiles at moderate strength: finer/stronger shimmers at distance
   279	  bump.repeat.set(700, 700);
   280	  bump.needsUpdate = true;
   281	  const mat = detailify(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
   282	    vertexColors: true, bumpMap: bump, bumpScale: 0.35,
   283	  }), 1.0);
   284	  terrainMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
   285	  terrainMesh.receiveShadow = true;
   286	  terrainMesh.name = 'terrain';
   287	  return terrainMesh;
   288	}
   289	
   290	// ---- per-era painting ------------------------------------------------------
   291	const c = new THREE.Color();
   292	let satMaterial = null, colorMaterial = null;
   293	export function paintEra(era) {
   294	  if (!colorMaterial) colorMaterial = terrainMesh.material;
   295	  // era 5: the real Sentinel-2 drape replaces painted colours entirely
   296	  if (era === 5) {
   297	    if (!satMaterial) {
   298	      const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(
   299	        'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + SAT_JPEG_B64,
   300	        (t) => { t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; t.anisotropy = 8; t.needsUpdate = true; }
   301	      );
   302	      satMaterial = detailify(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex }), 0.55);
   303	    }
   304	    terrainMesh.material = satMaterial;
   305	    return;
   306	  }
   307	  terrainMesh.material = colorMaterial;
   308	  const pos = terrainMesh.geometry.attributes.position;
   309	  const col = terrainMesh.geometry.attributes.color;
   310	
   311	  if (era === 0) {
   312	    // Younger Dryas tundra: till, gravel, moss, dryas heath — no meadow green
   313	    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
   314	      const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
   315	      const n1 = noise.fbm(x * 0.006, z * 0.006, 3);
   316	      const n2 = noise.noise2(x * 0.07, z * 0.07);
   317	      const dRiv = distToRiver(x, z);
   318	      let r = 0.36 + n1 * 0.13;
   319	      let g = 0.33 + n1 * 0.10 + n2 * 0.04;
   320	      let b = 0.23 + n2 * 0.04;
   321	      // moss carpets (green-dark) and dryas/rust heath patches
   322	      if (n2 > 0.62) { r += 0.05; g -= 0.015; b -= 0.05; }       // rust heath
   323	      else if (n2 < 0.32) { r -= 0.09; g -= 0.015; b -= 0.05; }  // dark moss
   324	      const n3 = noise.noise2(x * 0.02 + 9, z * 0.02);
   325	      if (n3 > 0.72) { r -= 0.05; g += 0.03; b -= 0.02; }        // sedge green flushes
   326	      // gravel outwash near water
   327	      if (dRiv < 26) {
   328	        const t = smoothstep(26, 7, dRiv);
   329	        r = lerp(r, 0.47, t); g = lerp(g, 0.43, t); b = lerp(b, 0.37, t);
   330	      }
   331	      // high till ridges paler
   332	      const high = smoothstep(210, 250, y);
   333	      r += high * 0.08; g += high * 0.07; b += high * 0.07;
   334	      col.setXYZ(i, r, g, b);
   335	    }
   336	    col.needsUpdate = true;
   337	    return;
   338	  }
   339	
   340	  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
   341	    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
   342	    const n1 = noise.fbm(x * 0.008, z * 0.008, 3);
   343	    const n2 = noise.noise2(x * 0.09, z * 0.09);
   344	    const dRiv = distToRiver(x, z);
   345	
   346	    // base meadow green, dryer on heights, lusher near water
   347	    let r = 0.275 + n1 * 0.14 + smoothstep(200, 245, y) * 0.10;
   348	    let g = 0.44 + n1 * 0.12 + smoothstep(60, 12, dRiv) * 0.05;
   349	    let b = 0.155 + n2 * 0.05;
   350	
   351	    // wildflower sparkle on open meadow (midsummer)
   352	    if (n2 > 0.82 && dRiv < 120 && era < 3) { r += 0.16; g += 0.1; b += 0.12; }
   353	
   354	    // forest floor — matched to where trees actually stand (vegetation thins
   355	    // with distance from the stage, so the floor tint must too)
   356	    const fd = forestDensity(era, x, z, y);
   357	    if (fd > 0.4) {
   358	      const dStage = Math.hypot(x - LOC.STEAD.x, z - LOC.STEAD.z);
   359	      const falloff = clamp(420 / Math.max(dStage, 1), 0.22, 1);
   360	      const t = smoothstep(0.4, 0.75, fd) * (0.35 + 0.65 * falloff);
   361	      r = lerp(r, 0.16, t); g = lerp(g, 0.2, t); b = lerp(b, 0.09, t);
   362	    }
   363	
   364	    // fields
   365	    const fa = fieldAt(era, x, z);
   366	    if (fa) {
   367	      const [fr, fg, fb] = FIELD_COLORS[fa.field.type];
   368	      const t = smoothstep(0.05, 0.3, fa.edge);
   369	      // plough-row striping
   370	      const s = Math.sin((x * Math.cos(fa.field.rot) + z * Math.sin(fa.field.rot)) * 1.8) * 0.045;
   371	      r = lerp(r, fr + s, t); g = lerp(g, fg + s, t); b = lerp(b, fb + s * 0.6, t);
   372	    }
   373	
   374	    // roads & yard earth — the real network: asphalt on today's P30 and
   375	    // V-roads, gravel elsewhere, bare dirt on the farm tracks
   376	    if (era >= 2) {
   377	      const ri = distToRoadEx(era, x, z);
   378	      if (ri.d < 2.5) {
   379	        const t = smoothstep(2.5, -1, ri.d);
   380	        if (era === 5 && ri.c <= 1) {
   381	          const lane = 0.30 + n2 * 0.03;
   382	          r = lerp(r, lane, t); g = lerp(g, lane + 0.008, t); b = lerp(b, lane + 0.02, t);
   383	        } else if (ri.c === 3) {
   384	          r = lerp(r, 0.42, t); g = lerp(g, 0.35, t); b = lerp(b, 0.25, t);
   385	        } else {
   386	          r = lerp(r, 0.44, t); g = lerp(g, 0.36, t); b = lerp(b, 0.26, t);
   387	        }
   388	      }
   389	    }
   390	    for (const p of PADS) {
   391	      if (era === 1 && p !== PADS[2]) continue;             // only the camp pad reads as trodden in AD 50
   392	      if (era === 2 && Math.hypot(x - LOC.MANOR.x, z - LOC.MANOR.z) < 80) continue;
   393	      if (era <= 2 && Math.hypot(x - LOC.KROGS.x, z - LOC.KROGS.z) < 40) continue;
   394	      if (era <= 2 && Math.hypot(x - LOC.BREZGA.x, z - LOC.BREZGA.z) < 30) continue;
   395	      const d = Math.hypot(x - p.x, z - p.z);
   396	      if (d < p.r * 0.75) {
   397	        const t = smoothstep(p.r * 0.75, p.r * 0.3, d) * 0.7;
   398	        r = lerp(r, 0.42 + n2 * 0.06, t); g = lerp(g, 0.35, t); b = lerp(b, 0.24, t);
   399	      }
   400	    }
   401	
   402	    // water margins, outside-in: moist grass -> sandy bank -> gravel -> mud
   403	    if (dRiv < 30) {
   404	      const moist = smoothstep(30, 15, dRiv);
   405	      g += moist * 0.05; r -= moist * 0.03;                     // damp grass greens up
   406	    }
   407	    if (dRiv < 16 && dRiv > 5.5) {
   408	      // the bank itself: bare sandy earth, distinct from the meadow
   409	      const bank = smoothstep(16, 11, dRiv);
   410	      r = lerp(r, 0.42 + n2 * 0.08, bank);
   411	      g = lerp(g, 0.36 + n2 * 0.05, bank);
   412	      b = lerp(b, 0.25, bank);
   413	    }
   414	    let wet = dRiv < 9 ? smoothstep(9, 3.5, dRiv) : 0;
   415	    const dStr = distToStreams(x, z);
   416	    if (dStr < 5) wet = Math.max(wet, smoothstep(5, 1.5, dStr));
   417	    for (const lake of LAKES) {
   418	      if (y < lake.level + 0.5 && Math.abs(x - lake.cx) < lake.hx && Math.abs(z - lake.cz) < lake.hz) {
   419	        wet = Math.max(wet, smoothstep(lake.level + 0.5, lake.level - 0.6, y));
   420	      }
   421	    }
   422	    if (wet > 0) {
   423	      r = lerp(r, 0.25, wet); g = lerp(g, 0.22, wet); b = lerp(b, 0.14, wet);
   424	      // sand & pebble bars right at the waterline (speckled by n2)
   425	      const bar = dRiv < 6.5 ? smoothstep(6.5, 1.5, dRiv) : 0;
   426	      if (bar > 0) {
   427	        const gravel = 0.36 + n2 * 0.14;
   428	        r = lerp(r, gravel + 0.05, bar); g = lerp(g, gravel, bar); b = lerp(b, gravel * 0.8, bar);
   429	      }
   430	    }
   431	
   432	    col.setXYZ(i, c.set(r, g, b).r, c.g, c.b);
   433	  }
   434	  col.needsUpdate = true;
   435	}

    19	// --- coarse water-distance field (30 m cells) — makes distToRiver/streams O(1)
    20	const WD_RES = 30;
    21	const WD_N = Math.ceil(HM_SPAN / WD_RES) + 1;
    22	const wdRiver = new Float32Array(WD_N * WD_N).fill(1e9);
    23	const wdLevel = new Float32Array(WD_N * WD_N);
    24	const wdStream = new Float32Array(WD_N * WD_N).fill(1e9);
    25	{
    26	  const x0 = HM_OFF_X - HM_SPAN / 2, z0 = HM_OFF_Z - HM_SPAN / 2;
    27	  for (let gz = 0; gz < WD_N; gz++) {
    28	    const z = z0 + gz * WD_RES;
    29	    for (let gx = 0; gx < WD_N; gx++) {
    30	      const x = x0 + gx * WD_RES;
    31	      const i = gz * WD_N + gx;
    32	      for (const p of RIVER_PTS) {
    33	        const d = (p[0] - x) * (p[0] - x) + (p[1] - z) * (p[1] - z);
    34	        if (d < wdRiver[i]) { wdRiver[i] = d; wdLevel[i] = p[2]; }
    35	      }
    36	      for (const s of STREAMS) for (const p of s.pts) {
    37	        const d = (p[0] - x) * (p[0] - x) + (p[1] - z) * (p[1] - z);
    38	        if (d < wdStream[i]) wdStream[i] = d;
    39	      }
    40	    }
    41	  }
    42	  for (let i = 0; i < WD_N * WD_N; i++) {
    43	    wdRiver[i] = Math.sqrt(wdRiver[i]);
    44	    wdStream[i] = Math.sqrt(wdStream[i]);
    45	  }
    46	  // refine near the channels with the SMOOTHED course the water ribbon
    47	  // actually follows — the raw 43m points overestimate by up to ~20m
    48	  // mid-span and miss the spline bulges on bends entirely (grass stood in
    49	  // the river on exactly those bends)
    50	  const sx0 = HM_OFF_X - HM_SPAN / 2, sz0 = HM_OFF_Z - HM_SPAN / 2;
    51	  const splat = (samples, arr, levelToo) => {
    52	    const W = 8; // 240m accuracy window; the coarse field covers beyond
    53	    for (const p of samples) {
    54	      const cgx = Math.round((p[0] - sx0) / WD_RES), cgz = Math.round((p[1] - sz0) / WD_RES);
    55	      for (let dz = -W; dz <= W; dz++) {
    56	        for (let dx = -W; dx <= W; dx++) {
    57	          const gx = cgx + dx, gz = cgz + dz;
    58	          if (gx < 0 || gz < 0 || gx >= WD_N || gz >= WD_N) continue;
    59	          const d = Math.hypot(sx0 + gx * WD_RES - p[0], sz0 + gz * WD_RES - p[1]);
    60	          const i = gz * WD_N + gx;
    61	          if (d < arr[i]) { arr[i] = d; if (levelToo) wdLevel[i] = p[2]; }
    62	        }
    63	      }
    64	    }
    65	  };
    66	  const NR = Math.min(2200, RIVER_PTS.length * 5);
    67	  const fineR = [];
    68	  for (let i = 0; i <= NR; i++) fineR.push(sampleSpline(RIVER_PTS, i / NR));
    69	  splat(fineR, wdRiver, true);
    70	  for (const st of STREAMS) {
    71	    const NS = st.pts.length * 5;
    72	    const fineS = [];
    73	    for (let i = 0; i <= NS; i++) fineS.push(sampleSpline(st.pts, i / NS));
    74	    splat(fineS, wdStream, false);
    75	  }

    77	function wdSample(arr, x, z) {
    78	  const fx = clamp((x - (HM_OFF_X - HM_SPAN / 2)) / WD_RES, 0, WD_N - 1.001);
    79	  const fz = clamp((z - (HM_OFF_Z - HM_SPAN / 2)) / WD_RES, 0, WD_N - 1.001);
    80	  const x0 = Math.floor(fx), z0 = Math.floor(fz);
    81	  const u = fx - x0, v = fz - z0;
    82	  const at = (xx, zz) => arr[Math.min(zz, WD_N - 1) * WD_N + Math.min(xx, WD_N - 1)];
    83	  return (at(x0, z0) * (1 - u) + at(x0 + 1, z0) * u) * (1 - v) +
    84	         (at(x0, z0 + 1) * (1 - u) + at(x0 + 1, z0 + 1) * u) * v;
    85	}

   308	export function fieldAt(era, x, z) {
   309	  const { fields, map } = fieldsIndexed(era);
   310	  const arr = map.get(Math.floor(x / FIELD_CELL) + ':' + Math.floor(z / FIELD_CELL));
   311	  if (!arr) return null;
   312	  for (const i of arr) {
   313	    const f = fields[i];
   314	    const dx = x - f.cx, dz = z - f.cz;
   315	    const c = Math.cos(-f.rot), s = Math.sin(-f.rot);
   316	    const u = (dx * c - dz * s) / f.rx, v = (dx * s + dz * c) / f.rz;
   317	    const d = u * u + v * v;
   318	    if (d < 1) return { field: f, edge: 1 - d };
   319	  }
   320	  return null;
   321	}

   337	}

   339	// spatial grid over road segments — distToRoad runs in the hot placement
   340	// loops and the real network is ~1400 segments
   341	const ROAD_CELL = 48;
   342	const roadGrids = new Map();
   343	function roadGridFor(era) {
   344	  let g = roadGrids.get(era);
   345	  if (g) return g;
   346	  const segs = [];
   347	  const map = new Map();
   348	  const all = roadsForEra(era).map((r) => ({ pts: r.pts, w: r.w, c: r.c === undefined ? 2 : r.c }))
   349	    .concat(osmRoadsFor(era));
   350	  for (const r of all) {
   351	    for (let i = 0; i < r.pts.length - 1; i++) {
   352	      const [ax, az] = r.pts[i], [bx2, bz] = r.pts[i + 1];
   353	      const idx = segs.length;
   354	      segs.push([ax, az, bx2, bz, r.w, r.c]);
   355	      const pad = r.w + 10;
   356	      const x0 = Math.floor((Math.min(ax, bx2) - pad) / ROAD_CELL), x1 = Math.floor((Math.max(ax, bx2) + pad) / ROAD_CELL);
   357	      const z0 = Math.floor((Math.min(az, bz) - pad) / ROAD_CELL), z1 = Math.floor((Math.max(az, bz) + pad) / ROAD_CELL);
   358	      for (let ix = x0; ix <= x1; ix++) {
   359	        for (let iz = z0; iz <= z1; iz++) {
   360	          const k = ix + ':' + iz;
   361	          let a = map.get(k);
   362	          if (!a) map.set(k, a = []);
   363	          a.push(idx);
   364	        }
   365	      }
   366	    }
   367	  }
   368	  g = { segs, map };
   369	  roadGrids.set(era, g);
   370	  return g;
   371	}
   372	
   373	// distance (minus road half-width) and road class of the nearest road.
   374	// Only exact within ~ROAD_CELL — every caller thresholds far below that.
   375	// which OSM farmstead sites exist in a given era — shared by the buildings
   376	// (eras.js), the orchards (vegetation.js) and the yard props so one farm
   377	// never gets an orchard without a house
   378	export function farmSiteKept(i, era) {
   379	  return mulberry32(i * 977 + era * 131)() < (era === 4 ? 0.96 : 0.6);
   380	}
   381	
   382	export function distToRoadEx(era, x, z) {
   383	  if (era <= 1) return { d: Infinity, c: 2 };
   384	  const { segs, map } = roadGridFor(era);
   385	  const cix = Math.floor(x / ROAD_CELL), ciz = Math.floor(z / ROAD_CELL);
   386	  let bd = Infinity, bc = 2;
   387	  for (let ix = cix - 1; ix <= cix + 1; ix++) {
   388	    for (let iz = ciz - 1; iz <= ciz + 1; iz++) {
   389	      const arr = map.get(ix + ':' + iz);
   390	      if (!arr) continue;
   391	      for (const si of arr) {
   392	        const s = segs[si];
   393	        const vx = s[2] - s[0], vz = s[3] - s[1];
   394	        const L = vx * vx + vz * vz;
   395	        const t = L ? clamp(((x - s[0]) * vx + (z - s[1]) * vz) / L, 0, 1) : 0;
   396	        const d = Math.hypot(x - (s[0] + vx * t), z - (s[1] + vz * t)) - s[4];
   397	        if (d < bd) { bd = d; bc = s[5]; }
   398	      }
   399	    }
   400	  }
   401	  return { d: bd, c: bc };
   402	}
   403	export function distToRoad(era, x, z) {
   404	  return distToRoadEx(era, x, z).d;
   405	}
   406	
   407	// --- Forest density 0..1 at a point, per era. y = ground elevation (m ASL).
   408	export function forestDensity(era, x, z, y) {
   409	  if (era === 0) {
   410	    // Younger Dryas tundra: no forest — dwarf-birch / juniper shrub heath
   411	    const n0 = noise.fbm(x * 0.003, z * 0.003, 3);
   412	    let d = smoothstep(0.38, 0.7, n0) * 0.34;
   413	    d *= smoothstep(8, 40, distToRiver(x, z)) * 0.85 + 0.15;
   414	    return clamp(d, 0, 0.36);
   415	  }
   416	  const n = noise.fbm(x * 0.0016, z * 0.0016, 4);
   417	  const dRiver = distToRiver(x, z);
   418	  const dStead = Math.hypot(x - S.x, z - S.z);
   419	  const dManor = Math.hypot(x - M.x, z - M.z);
   420	  const dCamp = Math.hypot(x - LOC.CAMP.x, z - LOC.CAMP.z);
   421	  let d;
   422	  if (era === 1) {
   423	    d = 0.68 + n * 0.4;                                     // primeval forest
   424	    d *= smoothstep(35, 120, dRiver) * 0.92 + 0.08;         // open floodplain meadows
   425	    d *= smoothstep(55, 135, dStead) * 0.94 + 0.06;         // the terrace opening where the aurochs graze
   426	    d *= smoothstep(12, 40, dCamp);                         // small camp clearing
   427	  } else if (era === 2) {
   428	    d = 0.56 + n * 0.46;
   429	    d *= smoothstep(15, 70, dRiver) * 0.9 + 0.1;
   430	    d *= smoothstep(42, 145, dStead);                       // farmstead clearing
   431	    d *= smoothstep(25, 80, Math.hypot(x - LOC.BARROWS.x, z - LOC.BARROWS.z));
   432	    for (const f of ERA2_FARMS) d *= smoothstep(18, 60, Math.hypot(x - f.x, z - f.z));
   433	  } else if (era === 5) {
   434	    // today: the real forest pattern from Sentinel-2
   435	    d = forestMaskAt(x, z) ? 0.85 + n * 0.15 : 0;
   436	    d *= smoothstep(55, 140, dStead) * 0.94 + 0.06;
   437	    d *= smoothstep(60, 150, dManor) * 0.94 + 0.06;
   438	  } else {
   439	    // agrarian mosaic: forest survives on high/steep hills and in patches
   440	    const high = smoothstep(208, 224, y);
   441	    const patch = smoothstep(0.56, 0.7, n);
   442	    d = Math.max(high * (0.5 + n * 0.55), patch * 0.95);
   443	    d *= smoothstep(70, 200, dStead) * 0.92 + 0.08;
   444	    d *= smoothstep(80, 220, dManor) * 0.92 + 0.08;
   445	    if (era === 4) d *= 0.9;
   446	    if (dRiver < 26 && dRiver > 12) d = Math.max(d, 0.35);
   447	    d *= smoothstep(20, 60, Math.hypot(x - K.x, z - K.z)) * 0.9 + 0.1; // krogs clearing
   448	  }
   449	  // universal exclusions
   450	  if (fieldAt(era, x, z)) return 0;
   451	  if (era >= 2 && distToRoad(era, x, z) < 3.5) return 0;
   452	  for (const p of PADS) if (Math.hypot(x - p.x, z - p.z) < p.r + 6) return 0;
   453	  if (dRiver < 11) return 0;
   454	  if (distToStreams(x, z) < 3.5) return 0;
   455	  return clamp(d, 0, 1);
   456	}

    10	function waterNormalTex() {
    11	  const n = makeNoise(777);
    12	  const tex = canvasTexture(256, 256, (ctx, w, h) => {
    13	    const img = ctx.createImageData(w, h);
    14	    // proper tangent-space normals derived from a ripple height field
    15	    const hgt = (x, y) =>
    16	      n.fbm((x / w) * 6, (y / h) * 6, 4) * 0.75 + n.noise2((x / w) * 22, (y / h) * 22) * 0.25;
    17	    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    18	      const dx = (hgt(x + 1, y) - hgt(x - 1, y)) * 3.2;
    19	      const dy = (hgt(x, y + 1) - hgt(x, y - 1)) * 3.2;
    20	      const inv = 1 / Math.hypot(dx, dy, 1);
    21	      const i = (y * w + x) * 4;
    22	      img.data[i] = (-dx * inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    23	      img.data[i + 1] = (-dy * inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    24	      img.data[i + 2] = (inv * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
    25	      img.data[i + 3] = 255;
    26	    }
    27	    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    28	  });
    29	  tex.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    30	  return tex;
    31	}

    33	function makeWaterMaterial(color, opacity) {
    34	  const m = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    35	    color,
    36	    shininess: 190,
    37	    specular: 0xb9c6d0,
    38	    transparent: true,
    39	    opacity,
    40	    normalMap: waterNormalTex(),
    41	    normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.26, 0.26),
    42	    side: THREE.DoubleSide, // river ribbons follow flow direction; don't let winding cull them
    43	  });
    44	  // second ripple octave scrolling against the first — interference, not slide
    45	  m.userData.off2 = new THREE.Vector2();
    46	  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    47	    sh.uniforms.uOff2 = { value: m.userData.off2 };
    48	    sh.fragmentShader = 'uniform vec2 uOff2;\n' + sh.fragmentShader.replace(
    49	      'vec3 mapN = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;',
    50	      `vec3 mapN1 = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
    51	       vec3 mapN2 = texture2D( normalMap, vNormalMapUv * 3.7 + uOff2 ).xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
    52	       vec3 mapN = normalize(vec3(mapN1.xy + mapN2.xy * 0.45, mapN1.z));`
    53	    );
    54	  };
    55	  return m;
    56	}

    58	// Water ribbon, LAAS-shore rules: high tessellation so bends are CURVES
    59	// (the old 63m segments read as rectangles), and a FLAT surface — the
    60	// shoreline comes from the carved bank rising through the plane.
    61	function ribbon(pts, widthFn, mat, uvScale = 60, edgeDrop = 0.85) {
    62	  // SEG and the tangent window MUST match the bank skirt exactly — the
    63	  // skirt's inner verts are meant to be vertex-for-vertex identical with
    64	  // these edges; any tessellation drift opens black slivers into the trench
    65	  const SEG = Math.min(2000, pts.length * 6);
    66	  // LAAS shore rule: the water surface is FLAT (a sloped surface reads as a
    67	  // convex hump from the bank) — only a slight edge tuck hides the seam.
    68	  // The shoreline itself comes from the bank rising THROUGH the plane, so
    69	  // the spline-following channel carve must clear the full ribbon width.
    70	  const EDGE_DROP = edgeDrop;
    71	  // 5 verts per row: the surface stays DEAD FLAT out to ~96% width, then a
    72	  // short near-vertical rim drops under the bank collar. A gradual slope
    73	  // read as a dark tilted band along every shore at grazing angles.
    74	  const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = [];
    75	  for (let i = 0; i <= SEG; i++) {
    76	    const t = i / SEG;
    77	    const [x, z, y] = sampleSpline(pts, t);
    78	    const [xa, za] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.max(0, t - 0.004));
    79	    const [x2, z2] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.min(1, t + 0.004));
    80	    let dx = x2 - xa, dz = z2 - za;
    81	    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    82	    dx /= len; dz /= len;
    83	    const w = widthFn(t) + 1.6; // overshoot into the banks
    84	    const wf = w - 0.5;         // flat out to here
    85	    positions.push(
    86	      x - dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z + dx * w,
    87	      x - dz * wf, y, z + dx * wf,
    88	      x, y, z,
    89	      x + dz * wf, y, z - dx * wf,
    90	      x + dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z - dx * w);
    91	    uvs.push(0, t * uvScale, 0.04, t * uvScale, 0.5, t * uvScale, 0.96, t * uvScale, 1, t * uvScale);
    92	    if (i < SEG) {
    93	      const a = i * 5;
    94	      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    95	        indices.push(a + k, a + k + 1, a + k + 6, a + k, a + k + 6, a + k + 5);
    96	      }
    97	    }
    98	  }
    99	  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   100	  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
   101	  geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
   102	  geo.setIndex(indices);
   103	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
   104	  return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
   105	}

   107	export function buildWater() {

   271	        ctx.beginPath();

   273	        ctx.fill();

   275	    });

   281	    }));

   285	  }

   288	  const streamMat = makeWaterMaterial(0x314f58, 0.92);

   303	  const pondLevel = LOC.POND_LEVEL;
   304	  pond.position.set(LOC.POND.x + 4, pondLevel, LOC.POND.z);
   305	  pond.name = 'pond';
   306	
   307	  function tick(t) {
   308	    for (const m of mats) {
   309	      m.normalMap.offset.set(t * 0.008, t * 0.013);
   310	      m.userData.off2.set(-t * 0.019, t * 0.011);
   311	    }
   312	  }
   313	  // glacial-era meltwater is milky with rock flour
   314	  const original = mats.map((m) => m.color.clone());
   315	  function setEra(era) {
   316	    mats.forEach((m, i) => {
   317	      if (era === 0) m.color.set(0x8fb6ba);
   318	      else m.color.copy(original[i]);
   319	    });
   320	  }
   321	  // sky reflections from an occasionally-refreshed cubemap
   322	  function applyEnvMap(tex) {
   323	    for (const m of mats) {
   324	      m.envMap = tex;
   325	      m.combine = THREE.MixOperation;
   326	      m.reflectivity = 0.33; // grazing-bright water vs Lambert land read as glare
   327	      m.needsUpdate = true;
   328	    }
   329	  }
   330	  return { group, pond, pondLevel, tick, setEra, applyEnvMap };
   331	}

    18	// one shared wind clock for every plant in the world
    19	export const WIND = {
    20	  time: { value: 0 },
    21	  dir: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.76, 0.48).normalize() },
    22	  strength: { value: 0.55 },
    23	};
    24	
    25	// Hierarchical wind (LAAS Wind.ts): per-branch flex/phase in the aWind
    26	// attribute, gust fronts travelling along the wind direction drive amplitude,
    27	// a second axis at ×1.31 draws Lissajous ellipses, cards get a fine flutter.
    28	export function windifyVeg(material) {
    29	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    30	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
    31	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
    32	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
    33	    sh.vertexShader =
    34	      'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS; attribute vec2 aWind;\n' +
    35	      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
    36	      #include <begin_vertex>
    37	      {
    38	        vec3 iPos = vec3(0.0);
    39	        #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
    40	        iPos = vec3(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][1], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
    41	        #endif
    42	        float phase = aWind.y + fract(sin(dot(iPos.xz, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) * 6.2831;
    43	        float gust = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(dot(iPos.xz, uWindD) * 0.02 - uWindT * 1.35 + phase * 0.13);
    44	        float f1 = 0.9 + fract(phase * 1.7) * 0.7;
    45	        float hK = min(transformed.y * 0.09, 1.2);
    46	        float lean = uWindS * uWindS * 0.35;
    47	        float swayA = sin(uWindT * f1 + phase) * gust * uWindS;
    48	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f1 * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    49	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.32 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.16 * swayB;
    50	        transformed.xz += disp * aWind.x * hK;
    51	        transformed += normal * (sin(uWindT * 4.7 + phase + transformed.x * 3.1)
    52	          * 0.02 * aWind.x * uWindS);
    53	      }
    54	      `);
    55	  };
    56	  return material;
    57	}

    59	// legacy vertex-colour wind (still used by the reeds and small props)
    60	export function windify(material) {
    61	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    62	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
    63	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
    64	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
    65	    sh.vertexShader = 'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS;\n' +
    66	      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
    67	      #include <begin_vertex>
    68	      #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
    69	      {
    70	        vec3 iPos = vec3(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][1], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
    71	        float phase = fract(sin(dot(iPos.xz, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) * 6.2831;
    72	        float flex = clamp((vColor.g - vColor.r) * 2.2, 0.0, 1.0) * transformed.y * transformed.y;
    73	        float gust = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(dot(iPos.xz, uWindD) * 0.018 - uWindT * 1.25 + phase * 0.31);
    74	        float f = 1.0 + fract(phase * 2.7) * 1.6;
    75	        float lean = uWindS * uWindS * 0.5;
    76	        float swayA = sin(uWindT * f + phase) * gust * uWindS;
    77	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    78	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.24 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.12 * swayB;
    79	        transformed.xz += disp * flex;
    80	      }
    81	      #endif
    82	      `);
    83	  };
    84	  return material;
    85	}

   170	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   171	// Materials
   172	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   173	function barkMaterial(tex) {
   174	  return windifyVeg(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, vertexColors: true }));
   175	}
   176	function cardMaterial(atlas) {
   177	  // alpha-to-coverage rides the composer's 4x MSAA: soft dithered leaf edges
   178	  // instead of the hard alpha-test fizz that reads as grit in the mips
   179	  // alphaTest 0.24 trims the mushy dither zone that read as half-rendered
   180	  // leaves up close while A2C still softens the silhouettes
   181	  const m = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
   182	    map: atlas, vertexColors: true, alphaTest: 0.24, alphaToCoverage: true,
   183	    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
   184	  });
   185	  windifyVeg(m);
   186	  const prev = m.onBeforeCompile;
   187	  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
   188	    prev(sh);
   189	    // sqrt-decode the atlas (captured sqrt-encoded for 8-bit precision)
   190	    sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace(
   191	      '#include <map_fragment>',
   192	      `#ifdef USE_MAP
   193	       vec4 sampledDiffuseColor = texture2D(map, vMapUv);
   194	       sampledDiffuseColor.rgb *= sampledDiffuseColor.rgb;
   195	       diffuseColor *= sampledDiffuseColor;
   196	       #endif`);
   197	  };
   198	  m.customDepthMaterial = null; // set on the mesh, not the material
   199	  return m;
   200	}
   201	function cardDepthMaterial(atlas) {
   202	  return new THREE.MeshDepthMaterial({
   203	    depthPacking: THREE.RGBADepthPacking, map: atlas, alphaTest: 0.38,
   204	  });
   205	}
   206	
   207	function makeInstanced(geo, mat, count, shadows) {
   208	  const m = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, count);
   209	  m.castShadow = shadows;
   210	  m.receiveShadow = false;
   211	  m.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
   212	  m.count = 0;
   213	  m.frustumCulled = false;
   214	  return m;
   215	}

   217	// species build order (also impostor atlas order)
   218	const SP_KEYS = ['spruce', 'pine', 'birch', 'oak', 'alder', 'linden', 'apple', 'shrub', 'snag'];
   219	// instance capacity per species: [full, far]. Two tiers only — real geometry
   220	// close to the points of interest, captured impostors beyond.
   221	const CAPS = {
   222	  spruce: [2100, 175000], pine: [1400, 125000], birch: [1700, 150000],
   223	  oak: [700, 42000], alder: [1100, 61000], linden: [330, 13000],
   224	  apple: [110, 1700], shrub: [8000, 55000], snag: [260, 0],

   228	export function buildVegetation(scene, renderer) {
   229	  const group = new THREE.Group();
   230	  group.name = 'vegetation';
   231	  scene.add(group);
   232	
   233	  // ---- per-species assets: geometry variants, atlases, materials ----------
   234	  const barkTexes = {};
   235	  const species = {};
   236	  const impostorEntries = [];
   237	  for (const key of SP_KEYS) {
   238	    const sp = SPECIES[key];
   239	    if (!barkTexes[sp.bark]) barkTexes[sp.bark] = barkTex(sp.bark);
   240	    const twigAtlas = sp.foliage ? captureTwigAtlas(renderer, sp, 900 + SP_KEYS.indexOf(key) * 17) : null;
   241	    const bMat = barkMaterial(barkTexes[sp.bark]);
   242	    const cMat = twigAtlas ? cardMaterial(twigAtlas) : null;
   243	    const full = [];
   244	    for (let v = 0; v < 2; v++) full.push(buildTree(sp, 3100 + SP_KEYS.indexOf(key) * 31 + v * 7));
   245	    species[key] = { sp, bMat, cMat, twigAtlas, full };
   246	    // impostor capture entry from full variant 0
   247	    if (CAPS[key][1] > 0) {
   248	      const t = full[0];
   249	      const bm = new THREE.Mesh(t.bark, bMat);
   250	      const meshes = [bm];
   251	      if (cMat) meshes.push(new THREE.Mesh(t.cards, cMat));
   252	      impostorEntries.push({
   253	        key, meshes,
   254	        halfW: t.skel.crownRadius * 1.25,
   255	        height: t.skel.height * 1.04,
   256	      });
   257	    }
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  // ---- far-tier impostors ---------------------------------------------------
   261	  const impostor = captureImpostorAtlas(renderer, impostorEntries);
   262	  // NO alpha-to-coverage here: on distant subpixel quads the 4-sample dither
   263	  // reads as fragmented, crawling silhouettes — a plain mid alpha test keeps
   264	  // far crowns solid
   265	  const impostorMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
   266	    map: impostor.texture, alphaTest: 0.22, side: THREE.DoubleSide, fog: true,
   267	  });
   268	  const farMeshes = {};
   269	  impostorEntries.forEach((e, i) => {
   270	    const tile = impostor.tiles[i];
   271	    // unit-height cross-quads, uv from the atlas tile
   272	    const w = tile.halfW / tile.height;
   273	    const pos = [], uv = [], idx = [], nrm = [];
   274	    // three planes at 60°: two-plane crosses read as flat cutouts from the
   275	    // diagonals — exactly where a walking player usually approaches them
   276	    for (const ang of [0, Math.PI / 3, (2 * Math.PI) / 3]) {
   277	      const c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
   278	      const b = pos.length / 3;
   279	      pos.push(-w * c, 0, -w * s, w * c, 0, w * s, w * c, 1, w * s, -w * c, 1, -w * s);
   280	      uv.push(tile.u0, 0, tile.u1, 0, tile.u1, 1, tile.u0, 1);
   281	      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) nrm.push(-s, 0.25, c);
   282	      idx.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3);
   283	    }
   284	    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   285	    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
   286	    geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
   287	    geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
   288	    geo.setIndex(idx);
   289	    farMeshes[e.key] = makeInstanced(geo, impostorMat, CAPS[e.key][1], false);
   290	    group.add(farMeshes[e.key]);
   291	  });
   292	
   293	  // ---- near-tier instanced meshes ------------------------------------------
   294	  // meshes[key] = { full: [{bark, cards}] }
   295	  const meshes = {};
   296	  for (const key of SP_KEYS) {
   297	    const S = species[key];
   298	    const mk = (variant, cap, shadows) => {
   299	      const bark = makeInstanced(variant.bark, S.bMat, cap, shadows);
   300	      let cards = null;
   301	      if (S.cMat) {
   302	        cards = makeInstanced(variant.cards, S.cMat, cap, shadows);
   303	        cards.customDepthMaterial = cardDepthMaterial(S.twigAtlas);
   304	      }
   305	      group.add(bark);
   306	      if (cards) group.add(cards);
   307	      return { bark, cards };
   308	    };
   309	    meshes[key] = {
   310	      full: S.full.map((v) => mk(v, Math.ceil(CAPS[key][0] / S.full.length), true)),
   311	      fullH: S.full.map((v) => v.skel.height),
   312	    };
   313	  }
   314	
   315	  // ---- understory assets -----------------------------------------------------
   316	  const fernAtlas = captureTwigAtlas(renderer, {
   317	    // pinnate frond reads through the needle-spray comb builder
   318	    foliage: {
   319	      kind: 'needleSpray', scale: [0.3, 0.42],
   320	      leaf: { len: 0.4, width: 0.05, shapePow: 1, fold: 0, curl: 0, needleCount: 40, brush: 0 },
   321	    },
   322	    foliageColor: { r: 0.10, g: 0.30, b: 0.09, hueVar: 0.3 },
   323	  }, 777);
   324	  const fernMat = cardMaterial(fernAtlas);
   325	  const fernGeo = buildFern(801);
   326	  const ferns = makeInstanced(fernGeo, fernMat, 14000, false);
   327	  ferns.customDepthMaterial = cardDepthMaterial(fernAtlas);
   328	  group.add(ferns);
   329	
   330	  const logMat = windifyVeg(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: barkTexes.spruce, vertexColors: true }));
   331	  const logGeos = [buildLog(311, 'mossy'), buildLog(313, 'rotten'), buildLog(317, 'fresh')];
   332	  const logs = logGeos.map((l) => makeInstanced(l.geometry, logMat, 1400, true));
   333	  const stumpGeo = buildStump(331);
   334	  const stumps = makeInstanced(stumpGeo.geometry, logMat, 800, true);
   335	  logs.forEach((l) => group.add(l));
   336	  group.add(stumps);
   337	
   338	  const boulderMat = windifyVeg(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ vertexColors: true }));

     4	export function mulberry32(seed) {
     5	  let a = seed >>> 0;
     6	  return function () {
     7	    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
     8	    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
     9	    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    10	    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    11	  };
    12	}

    14	export const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
    15	export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
    16	export const smoothstep = (a, b, v) => {
    17	  const t = clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
    18	  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    19	};

    21	// Deterministic 2D value noise with fbm
    22	export function makeNoise(seed = 1) {
    23	  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    24	  const P = 256, perm = new Uint8Array(P * 2), vals = new Float32Array(P);
    25	  for (let i = 0; i < P; i++) { perm[i] = i; vals[i] = rng(); }
    26	  for (let i = P - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = (rng() * (i + 1)) | 0; [perm[i], perm[j]] = [perm[j], perm[i]]; }
    27	  for (let i = 0; i < P; i++) perm[P + i] = perm[i];
    28	  const at = (xi, yi) => vals[perm[perm[xi & 255] + (yi & 255)]];
    29	  function noise2(x, y) {
    30	    const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y);
    31	    const xf = x - xi, yf = y - yi;
    32	    const u = xf * xf * (3 - 2 * xf), v = yf * yf * (3 - 2 * yf);
    33	    return lerp(lerp(at(xi, yi), at(xi + 1, yi), u), lerp(at(xi, yi + 1), at(xi + 1, yi + 1), u), v);
    34	  }
    35	  function fbm(x, y, oct = 4, lac = 2, gain = 0.5) {
    36	    let f = 0, amp = 0.5, fr = 1;
    37	    for (let i = 0; i < oct; i++) { f += amp * noise2(x * fr, y * fr); fr *= lac; amp *= gain; }
    38	    return f;
    39	  }
    40	  return { noise2, fbm, rng };
    41	}

    55	// Catmull-Rom sample over an array of [x, z(, y)] points, t in [0,1]
    56	export function sampleSpline(pts, t) {
    57	  const n = pts.length - 1;
    58	  const f = clamp(t, 0, 0.99999) * n;
    59	  const i = Math.floor(f), u = f - i;
    60	  const p = (k) => pts[clamp(k, 0, n)];
    61	  const c = (a, b, cc, d, uu) =>
    62	    0.5 * ((2 * b) + (-a + cc) * uu + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * cc - d) * uu * uu + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * cc + d) * uu * uu * uu);
    63	  const out = [];
    64	  for (let k = 0; k < p(0).length; k++) out[k] = c(p(i - 1)[k], p(i)[k], p(i + 1)[k], p(i + 2)[k], u);
    65	  return out;
    66	}

    68	export function pointInPoly(x, z, poly) {
    69	  let inside = false;
    70	  for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
    71	    const [xi, zi] = poly[i], [xj, zj] = poly[j];
    72	    if ((zi > z) !== (zj > z) && x < ((xj - xi) * (z - zi)) / (zj - zi) + xi) inside = !inside;
    73	  }
    74	  return inside;
    75	}

    77	export function distToPolyline(x, z, pts) {
    78	  let bd = Infinity;
    79	  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    80	    const ax = pts[i][0], az = pts[i][1], bx = pts[i + 1][0], bz = pts[i + 1][1];
    81	    const vx = bx - ax, vz = bz - az;
    82	    const L = vx * vx + vz * vz;
    83	    const t = L ? clamp(((x - ax) * vx + (z - az) * vz) / L, 0, 1) : 0;
    84	    const d = Math.hypot(x - (ax + vx * t), z - (az + vz * t));
    85	    if (d < bd) bd = d;
    86	  }
    87	  return bd;
    88	}
    89	
    90	export function splineLength(pts, samples = 200) {
    91	  let len = 0, prev = sampleSpline(pts, 0);
    92	  for (let i = 1; i <= samples; i++) {
    93	    const cur = sampleSpline(pts, i / samples);
    94	    len += Math.hypot(cur[0] - prev[0], cur[1] - prev[1]);
    95	    prev = cur;
    96	  }
    97	  return len;
    98	}

     1	// Near-field grass — LAAS GroundRing, WebGL edition, stable-world variant.
     2	// Four camera-following bands: a SHORT DENSE CARPET everywhere the ground is
     3	// green, tall blade CLUMPS near (per-pixel blade overlap is what reads as
     4	// "lush"), lighter clumps mid, crossed wide tufts far out to ~430m; beyond
     5	// that the terrain shader's sward speckle carries the look. Placement is
     6	// DETERMINISTIC PER WORLD CELL (hashed grid): as the rings move with the
     7	// camera the same world positions yield the same blades, so walking never
     8	// reshuffles the sward — new growth only fades in at the feathered rim.

    17	function cellSeed(ix, iz, salt) {
    18	  let h = Math.imul(ix, 374761393) ^ Math.imul(iz, 668265263) ^ Math.imul(salt, 2246822519);
    19	  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
    20	  return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0;
    21	}

    37	function bladeGeometry(segs) {
    38	  const pos = [], nrm = [], col = [], idx = [];
    39	  const W = 0.023, H = 1;
    40	  for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
    41	    const t = i / segs;
    42	    const w = W * (1 - t * 0.8);
    43	    const bendZ = t * t * 0.16; // gentle forward arc
    44	    const c0 = [0.115 + t * 0.21, 0.185 + t * 0.27, 0.06 + t * 0.1];
    45	    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    46	      pos.push(s * w, t * H, bendZ);
    47	      // rounded cross-section: edge normals tilt outward (LAAS ±38°)
    48	      nrm.push(s * 0.62, 0.25, -0.75);
    49	      col.push(c0[0] * (1 - 0.08 * s), c0[1], c0[2]);
    50	    }
    51	    if (i > 0) {
    52	      const b = (i - 1) * 2;
    53	      idx.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b + 1, b + 3, b + 2);
    54	    }
    55	  }
    56	  pos.push(0, H + 0.045, 0.19);
    57	  nrm.push(0, 0.35, -0.9);
    58	  col.push(0.36, 0.5, 0.18);
    59	  idx.push(segs * 2, segs * 2 + 1, pos.length / 3 - 1);
    60	  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    61	  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    62	  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
    63	  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    64	  g.setIndex(idx);
    65	  return g;
    66	}

    68	// N-blade clump merged into one instance
    69	function bladeClump(blades, segs, widthK = 1, spread = 0.22) {
    70	  let s = 1234567 + blades * 77 + segs * 13;
    71	  const rnd = () => { s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; };
    72	  const pos = [], nrm = [], col = [], idx = [];
    73	  const base = bladeGeometry(segs);
    74	  const p = base.attributes.position, nA = base.attributes.normal, cA = base.attributes.color;
    75	  const ix = base.index;
    76	  for (let b = 0; b < blades; b++) {
    77	    const yaw = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
    78	    const c = Math.cos(yaw), sn = Math.sin(yaw);
    79	    const ox = (rnd() - 0.5) * spread * 2, oz = (rnd() - 0.5) * spread * 2;
    80	    const hk = 0.62 + rnd() * 0.65;
    81	    const lean = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.42;
    82	    const vJ = 0.85 + rnd() * 0.3;
    83	    const v0 = pos.length / 3;
    84	    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    85	      const x = p.getX(i) * 1.25 * widthK, y = p.getY(i) * hk, z = p.getZ(i);
    86	      pos.push(x * c + z * sn + ox + lean * y * c, y, z * c - x * sn + oz + lean * y * sn);
    87	      nrm.push(nA.getX(i) * c + nA.getZ(i) * sn, nA.getY(i), nA.getZ(i) * c - nA.getX(i) * sn);
    88	      col.push(cA.getX(i) * vJ, cA.getY(i) * vJ, cA.getZ(i) * vJ);
    89	    }
    90	    for (let i = 0; i < ix.count; i++) idx.push(v0 + ix.getX(i));
    91	  }
    92	  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    93	  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    94	  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
    95	  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    96	  g.setIndex(idx);
    97	  return g;
    98	}

   100	// three crossed wide blades — far-band tuft
   101	function tuftGeometry(W = 0.06) {
   102	  const pos = [], nrm = [], col = [], idx = [];
   103	  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
   104	    const a = k * 1.92 + 0.4;
   105	    const c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);
   106	    const base = pos.length / 3;
   107	    for (const [u, v] of [[-W, 0], [W, 0], [W * 0.55, 1], [-W * 0.55, 1]]) {
   108	      pos.push(u * c, v, u * s);
   109	      const sgn = u < 0 ? -1 : 1;
   110	      nrm.push(-s * 0.76 + sgn * 0.62 * c, 0.25, c * 0.76 + sgn * 0.62 * s);
   111	      col.push((0.17 + v * 0.25) * 1.15, (0.25 + v * 0.3) * 1.15, (0.1 + v * 0.12) * 1.15);
   112	    }
   113	    idx.push(base, base + 2, base + 1, base, base + 3, base + 2);
   114	  }
   115	  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   116	  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
   117	  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
   118	  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
   119	  g.setIndex(idx);
   120	  return g;
   121	}

   123	function grassMaterial() {
   124	  const m = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ vertexColors: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
   125	  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
   126	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
   127	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
   128	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
   129	    sh.vertexShader = 'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS;\n' +
   130	      sh.vertexShader
   131	        .replace('#include <beginnormal_vertex>', `
   132	        #include <beginnormal_vertex>
   133	        // sward lights like the hillside: pull blade normals toward up
   134	        objectNormal = normalize(mix(objectNormal, vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 0.62));
   135	        `)
   136	        .replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
   137	        #include <begin_vertex>
   138	        #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
   139	        {
   140	          vec2 wp = vec2(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
   141	          float hash = fract(sin(dot(wp, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
   142	          float tN = clamp(position.y, 0.0, 1.5);
   143	          // gentle meadow breeze: shallow gust contrast, slow tempo, and the
   144	          // tip ARCS DOWN as it deflects (constant blade length) — the old
   145	          // curve stretched blades diagonally so gusts read as leaping flames
   146	          float gust = 0.68 + 0.32 * sin(dot(wp, uWindD) * 0.035 - uWindT * 1.5 + hash * 2.4);
   147	          float amp = uWindS * gust;
   148	          float bend = amp * (0.5 + uWindS * 0.4) * tN * tN * 0.24;
   149	          float flut = sin(uWindT * 3.8 + hash * 6.2832 + (wp.x + wp.y) * 0.9) * tN * amp * 0.03;
   150	          transformed.x += uWindD.x * bend - uWindD.y * flut;
   151	          transformed.z += uWindD.y * bend + uWindD.x * flut;
   152	          transformed.y -= bend * bend * (0.5 / max(tN, 0.05));
   153	        }
   154	        #endif
   155	        `);
   156	  };
   157	  return m;
   158	}

   160	// midsummer flowers: thin stem + head of crossed quads. kind 0 = white umbel
   161	// (meadowsweet / cow parsley, the Jāņi flower), 1 = ox-eye daisy, 2 = buttercup
   162	function flowerGeometry(kind) {
   163	  const pos = [], nrm = [], col = [], idx = [];
   164	  const H = kind === 0 ? 1 : 0.55;
   165	  const quad = (cxx, cy, cz, r, cr, cg, cb) => {
   166	    const b = pos.length / 3;
   167	    pos.push(cxx - r, cy, cz - r, cxx + r, cy, cz - r, cxx + r, cy, cz + r, cxx - r, cy, cz + r);
   168	    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { nrm.push(0, 1, 0); col.push(cr, cg, cb); }
   169	    idx.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3);
   170	  };
   171	  const b0 = pos.length / 3;
   172	  pos.push(-0.012, 0, 0, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.008, H, 0.05, -0.008, H, 0.05);
   173	  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { nrm.push(0, 0, 1); col.push(0.2, 0.34, 0.12); }
   174	  idx.push(b0, b0 + 1, b0 + 2, b0, b0 + 2, b0 + 3);
   175	  // a tilted petal: quad rising outward from (cx,cy,cz) at azimuth a
   176	  const petal = (cx, cy, cz, a, len, wid, tilt, cr, cg, cb) => {
   177	    const b = pos.length / 3;
   178	    const ca = Math.cos(a), sa = Math.sin(a);
   179	    const ux = -sa * wid, uz = ca * wid;             // width axis
   180	    const ox = ca * len * Math.cos(tilt), oz = sa * len * Math.cos(tilt);
   181	    const oy = len * Math.sin(tilt);
   182	    pos.push(
   183	      cx - ux, cy, cz - uz, cx + ux, cy, cz + uz,
   184	      cx + ox + ux * 0.4, cy + oy, cz + oz + uz * 0.4,
   185	      cx + ox - ux * 0.4, cy + oy, cz + oz - uz * 0.4);
   186	    const nx = -ca * Math.sin(tilt), ny = Math.cos(tilt), nz = -sa * Math.sin(tilt);
   187	    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { nrm.push(nx, ny, nz); col.push(cr, cg, cb); }
   188	    idx.push(b, b + 1, b + 2, b, b + 2, b + 3);
   189	  };
   190	  if (kind === 0) {
   191	    // meadowsweet: frothy cream dome — petals all over a hemisphere
   192	    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
   193	      const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4;
   194	      const up = i % 2 === 0 ? 0.85 : 0.35;
   195	      petal(Math.cos(a) * 0.03, H + 0.02 + (i % 2) * 0.025, 0.05 + Math.sin(a) * 0.03,
   196	        a, 0.075, 0.045, up, 0.93, 0.92, 0.84);
   197	    }
   198	    quad(0, H + 0.075, 0.05, 0.03, 0.96, 0.94, 0.86); // crown
   199	  } else if (kind === 1) {
   200	    // ox-eye daisy: 8 white petals radiating nearly flat + gold heart
   201	    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
   202	      petal(0, H + 0.02, 0.05, (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2, 0.062, 0.02, 0.22, 0.95, 0.95, 0.9);
   203	    }
   204	    quad(0, H + 0.034, 0.05, 0.018, 0.95, 0.78, 0.16);
   205	  } else {
   206	    // buttercup: 5 glossy cupped petals
   207	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   208	      petal(0, H + 0.02, 0.05, (i / 5) * Math.PI * 2, 0.034, 0.017, 0.65, 0.96, 0.78, 0.1);
   209	    }
   210	    quad(0, H + 0.028, 0.05, 0.01, 0.85, 0.62, 0.1);
   211	  }
   212	  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   213	  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
   214	  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
   215	  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
   216	  g.setIndex(idx);
   217	  return g;
   218	}

   220	export function buildGrass(scene) {
   221	  const geos = [bladeClump(10, 2, 1.55, 0.5), bladeClump(6, 2, 1.3, 0.35), bladeClump(8, 3), bladeClump(4, 2), tuftGeometry()];
   222	  const mat = grassMaterial();
   223	  const bands = BANDS.map((b, i) => {
   224	    const cells = Math.PI * b.r1 * b.r1 / (b.cell * b.cell);
   225	    const cap = Math.ceil(cells * b.perCell * 0.75); // rules thin ~40%+; headroom
   226	    const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geos[i], mat, cap);
   227	    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
   228	    mesh.castShadow = false;
   229	    mesh.receiveShadow = false;
   230	    mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
   231	    scene.add(mesh);
   232	    return { ...b, mesh, cap, lastX: 1e9, lastZ: 1e9, lastEra: -1, on: true, budget: 1 };
   233	  });
   234	  const flowerMeshes = [flowerGeometry(0), flowerGeometry(1), flowerGeometry(2)].map((g) => {
   235	    const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(g, mat, 1400);
   236	    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
   237	    mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
   238	    scene.add(mesh);
   239	    return mesh;
   240	  });

   242	  const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
   243	  const col = new THREE.Color();
   244	
   245	  // flowers on the same stable world grid (cell 6m, deterministic kinds)
   246	  function regenFlowers(cx, cz, era) {
   247	    const counts = [0, 0, 0];
   248	    if (era >= 1) {
   249	      const perCell = (era === 5 ? 0.28 : era >= 3 ? 0.56 : 1.12);
   250	      const R = 125, CELL = 6;
   251	      const ix0 = Math.floor((cx - R) / CELL), ix1 = Math.ceil((cx + R) / CELL);
   252	      const iz0 = Math.floor((cz - R) / CELL), iz1 = Math.ceil((cz + R) / CELL);
   253	      for (let iz = iz0; iz <= iz1; iz++) for (let ix = ix0; ix <= ix1; ix++) {
   254	        const rng = mulberry32(cellSeed(ix, iz, 51 + era));
   255	        const n = (perCell | 0) + (rng() < perCell % 1 ? 1 : 0);
   256	        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
   257	          const x = (ix + rng()) * CELL, z = (iz + rng()) * CELL;
   258	          const rot = rng() * 6.3, sc = 0.7 + rng() * 0.7, pick = rng();
   259	          const d = Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz);
   260	          if (d > R || d < 3) continue;
   261	          if (rng() < smoothstepJ(R * 0.75, R, d)) continue;   // feathered rim
   262	          const y = heightAt(x, z);
   263	          if (forestDensity(era, x, z, y) > 0.3) continue;
   264	          if (era >= 2 && (fieldAt(era, x, z) || distToRoad(era, x, z) < 2)) continue;
   265	          const dRiv = distToRiver(x, z);
   266	          if (dRiv < 4) continue;
   267	          const kind = dRiv < 45 ? (pick < 0.7 ? 0 : 2) : (pick < 0.55 ? 1 : 2);
   268	          if (counts[kind] >= 1400) continue;
   269	          dummy.position.set(x, y - 0.02, z);
   270	          dummy.rotation.set(0, rot, 0);
   271	          dummy.scale.set(sc, sc, sc);
   272	          dummy.updateMatrix();
   273	          flowerMeshes[kind].setMatrixAt(counts[kind]++, dummy.matrix);
   274	        }
   275	      }
   276	    }
   277	    flowerMeshes.forEach((m, i) => { m.count = counts[i]; m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; });
   278	  }

   280	  function regenerate(band, cx, cz, era) {
   281	    const { mesh, cell, carpet, wide, cellRules } = band;
   282	    const r0 = band.r0Dyn !== undefined ? band.r0Dyn : band.r0;
   283	    const r1 = band.r1;
   284	    const perCell = band.perCell * band.budget;
   285	    const cap = mesh.instanceMatrix.count;
   286	    const salt = 7 * era + BANDS.indexOf(BANDS.find((b) => b.key === band.key)) * 131 + 17;
   287	    // gather ring cells sorted centre-out so a full buffer drops the rim,
   288	    // never one side
   289	    const ix0 = Math.floor((cx - r1) / cell), ix1 = Math.ceil((cx + r1) / cell);
   290	    const iz0 = Math.floor((cz - r1) / cell), iz1 = Math.ceil((cz + r1) / cell);
   291	    const cellsArr = [];
   292	    for (let iz = iz0; iz <= iz1; iz++) for (let ix = ix0; ix <= ix1; ix++) {
   293	      const ccx = (ix + 0.5) * cell, ccz = (iz + 0.5) * cell;
   294	      const d2 = (ccx - cx) * (ccx - cx) + (ccz - cz) * (ccz - cz);
   295	      if (d2 > (r1 + cell) * (r1 + cell)) continue;
   296	      if (r0 > 0 && d2 < (r0 - cell) * (r0 - cell) * 0.6) continue;
   297	      cellsArr.push([d2, ix, iz]);
   298	    }
   299	    cellsArr.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
   300	    let i = 0;
   301	    for (const [, ix, iz] of cellsArr) {
   302	      if (i >= cap) break;
   303	      const rng = mulberry32(cellSeed(ix, iz, salt));
   304	      const n = (perCell | 0) + (rng() < perCell % 1 ? 1 : 0);
   305	      // dense bands: rules once per 1.3m cell — blades that close together
   306	      // share their fate, and per-blade rule checks made walk-regen hitch
   307	      let cellOK = true, cFa = null, cTrodden = false, cDRiv = 0, cY = 0;
   308	      if (cellRules) {
   309	        const ccx = (ix + 0.5) * cell, ccz = (iz + 0.5) * cell;
   310	        cY = heightAt(ccx, ccz);
   311	        cDRiv = distToRiver(ccx, ccz);
   312	        if (cDRiv < 16.5 || (cDRiv < 21 && cY < riverLevelNear(ccx, ccz) + 0.6)) cellOK = false;
   313	        if (cellOK) {
   314	          for (const lake of LAKES) {
   315	            if (cY < lake.level + 0.5 && pointInPoly(ccx, ccz, lake.poly)) { cellOK = false; break; }
   316	          }
   317	        }
   318	        let cFd = 0;
   319	        if (cellOK) {
   320	          cFd = forestDensity(era, ccx, ccz, cY);
   321	          if (!band.roadPerBlade && era >= 2 && distToRoad(era, ccx, ccz) < 1.2) cellOK = false;
   322	        }
   323	        if (cellOK) {
   324	          for (const p of PADS) {
   325	            if (era === 1 && p !== PADS[2]) continue;

   447	  // FPS governor: shed pixel ratio, shadow rate/size, then grass density —
   448	  // never the trees. Kicks in early (below ~34fps) so it never feels laggy
   449	  // for long.
   450	  const gov = { acc: 0, frames: 0, level: 0, shadowEvery: 2, shadowTick: 0 };
   451	  const GOV_STEPS = [
   452	    { pr: Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.75), grass: 1, shadowEvery: 2, shadowMap: 4096 },
   453	    { pr: Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5), grass: 0.85, shadowEvery: 3, shadowMap: 4096 },
   454	    { pr: 1.25, grass: 0.65, shadowEvery: 4, shadowMap: 2048 },
   455	    { pr: 1.0, grass: 0.45, shadowEvery: 5, shadowMap: 2048 },
   456	  ];
   457	  function applyGov(s) {
   458	    renderer.setPixelRatio(s.pr);
   459	    composer.setPixelRatio(s.pr);
   460	    composer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
   461	    grass.setBudget(s.grass);
   462	    gov.shadowEvery = s.shadowEvery;
   463	    if (sky.sun.shadow.mapSize.x !== s.shadowMap) {
   464	      sky.sun.shadow.mapSize.set(s.shadowMap, s.shadowMap);
   465	      if (sky.sun.shadow.map) { sky.sun.shadow.map.dispose(); sky.sun.shadow.map = null; }
   466	    }
   467	  }
   468	  function govern(dt) {
   469	    gov.acc += dt; gov.frames++;
   470	    if (gov.acc < 3) return;
   471	    const fps = gov.frames / gov.acc;
   472	    gov.acc = 0; gov.frames = 0;
   473	    if (fps < 34 && gov.level < GOV_STEPS.length - 1) {
   474	      gov.level++;
   475	      applyGov(GOV_STEPS[gov.level]);
   476	    }
   477	  }
   478	  window.__gov = gov;

import { RIVER_PTS, LAKES } from './src/geodata.js';
import { distToRiver, riverLevelNear, forestDensity, fieldAt, LOC } from './src/landuse.js';
import { heightAt } from './src/terrain.js';
import { sampleSpline, clamp, mulberry32, pointInPoly, smoothstep as smoothstepJ } from './src/util.js';

function exactDistRiver(x,z) {
  let bd = Infinity, bestT = 0;
  const N = 6000;
  let prev = sampleSpline(RIVER_PTS, 0);
  for (let i=1;i<=N;i++) {
    const cur = sampleSpline(RIVER_PTS, i/N);
    const ax=prev[0], az=prev[1], bx=cur[0], bz=cur[1];
    const vx=bx-ax, vz=bz-az, L=vx*vx+vz*vz;
    const t=L?clamp(((x-ax)*vx+(z-az)*vz)/L,0,1):0;
    const px=ax+vx*t, pz=az+vz*t;
    const d=Math.hypot(x-px,z-pz);
    if (d<bd) { bd=d; bestT=(i-1+t)/N; }
    prev=cur;
  }
  return [bd,bestT];
}
function cellSeed(ix, iz, salt) {
  let h = Math.imul(ix, 374761393) "'^ Math.imul(iz, 668265263) ''^ Math.imul(salt, 2246822519);
  h = Math.imul(h ''^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);

}
function flowers(cx,cz,era) {
  const out=[];

  const iz0 = Math.floor((cz - R) / CELL), iz1 = Math.ceil((cz + R) / CELL);
  const counts = [0,0,0];
  for (let iz=iz0; iz<=iz1; iz++) for (let ix=ix0; ix<=ix1; ix++) {
    const rng = mulberry32(cellSeed(ix, iz, 51 + era));
    const n = (perCell | 0) + (rng() < perCell % 1 ? 1 : 0);
    for (let k=0;k<n;k++) {
      const x = (ix + rng()) * CELL, z = (iz + rng()) * CELL;
      const rot = rng() * 6.3, sc = 0.7 + rng() * 0.7, pick = rng();
      const d = Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz);
      if (d > R || d < 3) continue;
      if (rng() < smoothstepJ(R * 0.75, R, d)) continue;
      const y = heightAt(x,z);
      if (forestDensity(era,x,z,y) > 0.3) continue;
      // ignore road/field here? use fieldAt only as code for era>=2 but road not imported exact; field enough for water proof? Need no roads in water.
      if (era >= 2 && fieldAt(era,x,z)) continue;
      const dRiv=distToRiver(x,z);
      if (dRiv < 4) continue;
      const kind = dRiv < 45 ? (pick < 0.7 ? 0 : 2) : (pick < 0.55 ? 1 : 2);
      if (counts[kind] >= 1400) continue;
      counts[kind]++;
      const [exact,t] = exactDistRiver(x,z);
      if (exact <= 11.8) out.push({x,z,y,dRiv,exact,t,kind,sc});
    }
  }

}

That directly affects grass exclusion and `microDamp`, so I’m taking targeted screenshots at one of those coordinates to see whether the artifact is visible.

    22	// One closed roof solid: eaves rectangle + ridge segment. ridgeHalf = D gives
    23	// a gable (vertical closed ends); ridgeHalf < D gives a hip.
    24	function roofSolid(w, d, h, mat, over, ridgeHalf) {
    25	  const W = w / 2 + over, D = d / 2 + over;
    26	  const R = Math.min(ridgeHalf, D);
    27	  // slight eave drop so the overhang slopes with the roof plane
    28	  const drop = (over / (w / 2)) * h * 0.8;
    29	  const pos = [
    30	    -W, -drop, -D, W, -drop, -D, W, -drop, D, -W, -drop, D,   // eaves corners
    31	    0, h, -R, 0, h, R,                                        // ridge ends
    32	  ];
    33	  // faces: two slopes (quads) + two ends (triangles) — non-indexed for crisp edges
    34	  const quads = [
    35	    [0, 4, 5, 3],   // west slope (x<0)
    36	    [1, 2, 5, 4],   // east slope (x>0)
    37	  ];
    38	  const tris = [
    39	    [0, 1, 4],      // north end
    40	    [2, 3, 5],      // south end
    41	  ];
    42	  const verts = [], uvs = [];
    43	  const push = (i) => {
    44	    verts.push(pos[i * 3], pos[i * 3 + 1], pos[i * 3 + 2]);
    45	    uvs.push((pos[i * 3] + pos[i * 3 + 1]) / 3.2, pos[i * 3 + 2] / 3.2);
    46	  };
    47	  for (const [a, b, c, dd] of quads) { push(a); push(b); push(c); push(a); push(c); push(dd); }
    48	  for (const [a, b, c] of tris) { push(a); push(b); push(c); }
    49	  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    50	  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(verts, 3));
    51	  geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
    52	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
    53	  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    54	  mesh.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
    55	  return mesh;
    56	}
